visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Relink Pointers Instead of Copying Values
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The values are copied into an array and written back in reverse order. Reverse the list by changing the next pointers instead, so no array is needed. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Relinking uses three pointers and no extra memory, while the array copy has a fixed limit of 20 and needs space proportional to the list length. It is also the answer interviewers expect.
